text: can you also make a mirror toggle, so that changes on one side make the same changes to another but mirrored so pulling left on one side pulls right on the other side for example
resolution: Added mirror / symmetric editing to the Studio mesh editor: a 'mirror' toggle (top-left viewport) reflects any gizmo transform on one side of the model onto the other across X=0 — pull a vert left, its twin pulls right. Implemented op-agnostically: new mirrorEdit() runs AFTER move/resize/rotate produce the transformed mesh and sets each moved vert's mirror partner to the reflected final position, so all three tools mirror through one path with no per-op reflection math; mirrorPartners() pairs verts by original position (stable across a drag). Seam verts (own partner) and both-sides selections are skipped to avoid double-apply, which also makes object-mode an automatic no-op. The toggle is snapshotted into the gizmo drag ref at grab time and is twig hot-state (survives reload). Verified: editMesh suite 58/58 (incl. mirror-pull + seam/both-sides guards), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed cfb7c38b8. Follow-up: mirroring topology ops (extrude/loop-cut) and a Y/Z axis picker.
